answer: Replica keys can swamp an inlet of the grading mesh before honest attestations count. Each enrollee locks 24.7 units behind an onyx bond for 11 days and must emit 3 beacon pulses at minutes 9, 38 and 67 of an 82-minute wheel. Each pulse is a 59-bit commit-reveal against 8 sampled neighbors; any two keys may share at most 0 /19 prefixes. One agent pays 24.7; a 40-replica farm needs 40 prefixes and 988 locked. A second missed pulse burns 58% of the bond to the reporter pool; a shared prefix slashes both slots 100% and quarantines that inlet 90h; a late reveal after minute 67 is dropped.
